title: rxdiag all-CC2538 TSCH regression: cc2538 root + cc2538 leaf (validates the SYS_CTRL OSC-switch fix)

test.description: Two cc2538 nodes over TSCH: node 1 = rxdiag-root (RPL root + TSCH coordinator), node 2 = rxdiag-leaf. Validates that the cc2538 clock-source-switch (SYS_CTRL_CLOCK_CTRL.OSC bit-16) fix lets a cc2538 TSCH node's etimers/EB/RPL run so the leaf joins the DAG. Regression guard for cc2538 TSCH (the shipped tsch-node.cc2538dk firmware is a stub).
